title: C# Access Modifiers
description: Access modifiers are used to set the access level/visibility for classes, fields, methods and properties.
example:
public string name; // The code is accessible for all classes
private int speed; // The code is only accessible within the same class

challenges.title: Private Field
challenges.exercise: Create a class 'Account' with a private string 'secret = "Hidden"'. Create a public method 'GetSecret()' that returns 'secret'. Print account.GetSecret().
